propositions: Operator-attested evidence currently lacks provenance context (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument), allowing measurements taken in wrong environments or under broader privileges than production to satisfy the evidence contract.

The contract must be extended to require explicit declaration of measurement context — environment (AWS account/cluster/tenant), principal identity, privilege posture relative to production, and instrument type (live-call/simulation/static-analysis) — as a continuation line under each [operator-attested] checkbox item.

A deterministic check module (det_measurement_provenance.py) must validate presence and non-placeholder values of all four provenance fields and enum membership, making no judgement about correctness — only structure.

An advisory AGENT-tier criterion (project.measurement-provenance) must be activated via .rebar/ project overlay with agentic execution mode to compare declared environment against in-repo IaC anchors and flag simulation/static-analysis as evidence for authorization claims.

Escaped measurement scenarios — wrong account (579718921998 declared vs 896586841071 in backend), and live calls under bedrock:* privilege masking scoped grant failures — must become repo-checkable contradictions once provenance is forced into the attestation record.
